renderer.title: Bare URL containing an ampersand
renderer.note: Bare-URL autolinking is a local extension, not CommonMark; the link stops at "&" and the remainder is plain text.

renderer.title: Image syntax
renderer.note: Images are outside the supported subset; output is a literal "!" plus a link, not an image.

renderer.note: GFM task lists are outside the supported subset; brackets are shown literally.
